newsitem.title: USA: Glickman sees next Congress looking at farm bill.
newsitem.headline: Glickman sees next Congress looking at farm bill.

text.p: U.S. Agriculture Department Secretary Dan Glickman said he thought Congress would take another look at the farm bill next term.

"Congress takes a look at the farm bill every year. Now whether they will do a radical or revolutionary change to the farm bill, I doubt that's going to happen but there are some problems..." Glickman told reporters in Baton Rouge.
The secretary's remarks were made available by USDA Radio.
Glickman cited problems with the credit provisions and said lawmakers may also need to straighten out problems with the relationship between landlords and farm tenants.
